reasons: AC1-AC3 bound to ac<N>-* nodes; trace.json records 22/22 nodes true (5 setup-, 16 ac<N>-, 1 teardown-) and summary.json reports failed: 0.
AC3 divergence proven live and read-only: streamedAccountPresent=false ('0') vs fresh perpsGetAccountState '763.276429', decisions disagree on a $381 withdrawal.

AC1/AC2 asserted by strict eq on jest JSON (4 and 5 passing cases, 0 failures), not by screenshots; the Perps cases seed the streamed cache with the opposite-decision value and assert the singleton is never consulted.

Reverting the hook to its pre-fix form fails 18 of 20 cases; every branch flagged as mutation-surviving in review (missing account, per-scope guard, request coalescing, distinct alert key, short button label, hide-results and metrics entries) now fails at least one case.

graph_integrity.reason: Single linear workflow, every node reachable from setup-status, terminal teardown-done reached with status pass; no switch, no wait, no manual action.

action_contract.reason: Only manifest-declared actions used (app.status, cdp.target, metamask.wallet.ensure_unlocked, ui.navigate, ui.wait_for, ui.screenshot, command, assert_json, assert_file, end); runner v1 validation passed on both recipes.

ac_coverage.reason: Every AC maps to ac<N>-* nodes with at least one strict assertion, and each test-backed AC also asserts the matched-case count (4 for AC1, 5 for AC2, 1 for AC3) so an empty jest filter cannot pass silently.

evidence_contract_basics.reason: Hidden hook/controller claims are proven by test and live state artifacts; the single screenshot is preceded by ui.wait_for on its claimed target and is used for orientation only, not as proof of hidden behaviour. The final run's artifact-manifest records provider capture-helper / mode snapshot with fallbackFrom null — an earlier run had fallen back to Page.captureScreenshot after a wedged capture-helper session, which was cleared and the evidence recaptured.

perps_state_setup.reason: Required Perps state (funded testnet account, then an empty streamed cache) is built by the recipe itself: setup-warm-streamed-cache opens Perps, setup-leave-perps returns to a non-Perps screen, and the probe restarts the UI realm so the cache is deterministically empty while the fresh balance stays 763.276429.

mobile_alignment.reason: Mobile's useWithdrawValidation validates against usePerpsLiveAccount (a live subscription); the Extension alert runs for every confirmation type, so the fix uses a perpsWithdraw-gated fresh perpsGetAccountState read as the equivalent, keeping non-Perps confirmations free of Perps traffic.

contextual_findings.message: The MM Pay Perps withdraw confirmation cannot be opened in this slot: createPerpsWithdrawTransaction needs Arbitrum gas estimation and every EVM RPC call fails with "Failed to execute 'fetch' on 'WorkerGlobalScope': Illegal invocation". Verified environmental (direct fetch of the same RPC URL in the service worker returns 200; an unbound fetch there throws the identical error; reproduces on LavaMoat and non-LavaMoat builds with an unmodified tree). AC3 is therefore proven by live state probe plus hook test, which the AC explicitly allows.

suggested_recipe_delta: Once EVM RPC works in the slot, extend the recipe with ac3-open-withdraw-confirmation / ac3-set-amount / ac3-assert-blocking-alert nodes to capture the confirmation screen itself, replacing the orientation screenshot with a real before/after of the blocking alert.
